description: List the customer's billable services (VPS, hosting, dedicated, domains) — each with its service id, product name, status, billing cycle and next due date. Use this to find the numeric `service_id` for the `impreza_vps_*` tools. Optional `status` filter.

status.description: Filter by service status (e.g. Active, Suspended, Terminated).

name: impreza_list_services
